question: Within a radius of 160 kilometers, where can I locate café on the journey from Strawberry Hill, San Francisco, CA to Sculpture Plaza, Mountain View, CA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Strawberry Hill%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sculpture Plaza%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mountain View%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 160000 ) );
